primary.title: Chose the new tax regime? Here are 5 ways to reduce your tax while filing ITR for AY 2026-27
primary.summary: The new tax regime features lower rates with fewer deductions, leading many salaried taxpayers to think they can't reduce tax liabilities. However, there are tax-saving provisions available. Here are five ways to lower your tax outgo.
